about: arcpy's public callable names per module, read with dir() from arcpy in ArcGIS Pro 3.7 on 2026-10-29 by the owner's licensed install: names only, each a public, documented API name; nothing else was read. Toolbox aliases (Buffer_analysis) are left out, as grapy keeps the module form. ADR-223 condition 6; widened to ADR-224's group 1 (sa, ia, ddd, ga added) the same day. Group 2's network modules (na, nax, nd) were added on 2026-10-30, when ADR-226 began building them. The utility network module (un, 124 names) was added on 2026-10-30, read the same way, when ADR-231 began building it.
